page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 128 dedicated vCPUs. The processing power is driven by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Additionally, there are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

For network connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the high core count and balanced memory configuration, this instance is designed for large-scale general-purpose workloads, such as enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized database deployments that require substantial parallel processing capabilities without specialized memory-to-core ratios.
